title: Unified Evidence-First, Step-Useful, and Contrast-Identifiable Rubric for Human-Like Tool SFT
evaluation_unit: one fully executed trajectory, its transcript-level step-value dataflow audit, any student-visible multi-candidate evidence adjudication, its private label-blind intervention sidecar, three causal counterfactual replays, the batch-level reasoning-diversity audit, and a policy-invisible structure-matched semantic-neighborhood ledger

research_lineage.borrowed_principle: externalize policy state and train on actions that actually execute in the same Harness used at inference time
research_lineage.adaptation: candidate claims, field obligations, EvidenceAtoms, challenges, assessments, bindings, commitments, and terminal state are explicit and replayable

research_lineage.borrowed_principle: video deep research should be a multi-tool, multi-turn evidence acquisition process rather than one-shot answering
research_lineage.adaptation: dataset-specific measurements live behind one dependency-ordered action grammar

research_lineage.borrowed_principle: a correct final answer does not certify intermediate reasoning
research_lineage.adaptation: every positive SFT target must execute, create or consume visible state, and state its downstream consequence

research_lineage.source: causal scrubbing, program slicing, and dataflow liveness analysis
research_lineage.borrowed_principle: a state-changing operation is useful only when its output lies on a later decision path; successful execution alone does not establish necessity
research_lineage.adaptation: follow every created EvidenceAtom and every opened, revised, bound, or committed field to a later assessment, adjudication, binding, commitment, challenge resolution, or terminal decision

research_lineage.source: counterfactual evaluation and causal data attribution
research_lineage.borrowed_principle: use interventions to distinguish causal steps from plausible narration
research_lineage.adaptation: clean-control, moved-defect, and fresh-evidence-removal probes accompany every recovery episode

research_lineage.borrowed_principle: training data must cover states induced by earlier mistakes, not only clean expert prefixes
research_lineage.adaptation: unannounced evidence corruption creates complete challenge-to-recovery suffixes without revealing a repair recipe

research_lineage.source: ensemble diversity, selective prediction, and process supervision
research_lineage.borrowed_principle: correlated repetitions are not independent votes, abstention is preferable to unsupported certainty, and a correct final answer does not validate a biased selection process
research_lineage.adaptation: adjudication gives one vote per measurement method, resolves direction without consulting the current claim, preserves an explicit abstention candidate, and is recomputed from raw student-visible EvidenceAtoms

research_lineage.source: contrast sets, counterfactual data augmentation, and hard-negative curriculum
research_lineage.borrowed_principle: examples that share superficial structure but require different labels reveal shortcuts and create more informative supervision than unmatched examples
research_lineage.adaptation: form an n-ary SFT neighborhood only when dataset, stage, eligible-tool set, and visible tool schemas match while at least two abstract teacher actions differ; keep neighborhood metadata outside the student transcript and preserve every original trajectory

hard_gates.name: executed_safe_outcome
hard_gates.failure: Any positive target was not executed; a tool call was rejected; the final state is nonterminal; a required field is unsupported, conflicted, or uncommitted; or provenance remains open.

hard_gates.name: identity_scope_and_role_integrity
hard_gates.failure: Evidence belongs to another task/entity/role/scope, source and suspect coordinate frames are conflated, or logical IDs, media roles, and intervals are not supported by student-visible evidence.

hard_gates.name: control_plane_autonomy
hard_gates.failure: The student sees oracle values, verifier results, intervention names, restoration values, compiled target actions, materialized next-tool answers, or a categorical router answer.

hard_gates.name: complete_unannounced_recovery
hard_gates.failure: The policy misses a visible defect, challenges the wrong atom or fields, requests an unrelated check, fails to obtain fresh evidence, omits a required multi-candidate adjudication, chooses evidence by compatibility with the current claim, reuses rejected or superseded evidence, repairs unrelated fields, or stops before local recovery or principled abstention.

hard_gates.name: explicit_claim_value_revision
hard_gates.failure: Fresh evidence or a completed evidence-first adjudication directly supports a different claim value but the trajectory silently preserves the stale value, changes a committed field without reopening it, revises a field without one unambiguous selected active visible support, lets rejected evidence re-enter revision or binding, or combines revision, binding, and commitment into one unverifiable action.

hard_gates.name: causal_counterfactual_response
hard_gates.failure: A clean control still challenges; moving the defect does not move the challenge target; deleting all fresh evidence still permits the same repair; or an irrelevant change alters independent fields.

hard_gates.name: reasoning_target_integrity
hard_gates.failure: Any assistant target has empty reasoning, truncation/placeholder artifacts, no student-visible grounding, no explanation of the action's state consequence, an implausible length, or the batch exceeds the declared duplication/concentration limits.
hard_gates.why_ordinary_tests_are_insufficient: The v2 compiler executed and passed structural counterfactual checks while every fresh_binding target serialized content=null. Type/schema checks validate tool arguments, not the pedagogical content of assistant text; therefore an explicit reasoning-content audit is required.

hard_gates.name: independent_blind_review
hard_gates.failure: Fewer than two blind judges review the student-visible trajectories, a dimension mean is below 4/5, or a score disagreement above one point remains unadjudicated.

full_credit_requires: every target tool is eligible and actually executed or accepted
every target produces a material state delta
every created EvidenceAtom is later assessed, adjudicated, bound, used to resolve the challenge, or retained as a visible adaptive-routing prerequisite
reopen, revision, binding, and commitment operate only on the dependent target-field slice and are consumed by a later state transition
repeating the same external method requires changed arguments and a visible inconclusive routing state
C5.aggregation: conjunctive episode-level credit: any executed-but-unused or scope-drifting positive target makes C5=0; partial averaging cannot hide one busywork step
C5.concrete_failure_scenario: An eligible extra media tool executes successfully, adds a fresh EvidenceAtom, and leaves the final answer valid, but no later assessment, adjudication, binding, challenge resolution, or terminal support references the atom. UTQR-11 awarded full C5 because eligibility, material state delta, and non-duplication all remained true.
C5.why_ordinary_checks_are_insufficient: Schema validation proves the call is well formed; execution proves it ran; state-delta checks prove it changed the transcript; terminal and binding checks prove the episode eventually succeeds. None establishes that the new observation influenced a decision. Git, version numbers, types, uniqueness constraints, and ordinary unit tests likewise cannot infer downstream evidence use.

required_action_grammar: detect a concrete student-visible integrity defect
challenge named active EvidenceAtoms with the minimal affected field subset
execute the requested real context or measurement tool
name the resulting fresh EvidenceAtoms and explain what they change or preserve
when active evidence competes, assess every candidate before selecting a winner

adjudicate without consulting the current claim: count at most one vote per measurement method, prefer unopposed cross-method directional agreement, and retain explicit abstention when directional evidence conflicts
when the selected atom uniquely supports a different value, explicitly revise only the reopened field after adjudication
bind only fresh active evidence selected by adjudication; when adjudication is not applicable, bind only evidence semantically compatible with the claim
never allow rejected or superseded evidence to re-enter revision, binding, commitment, or stop
request stop only after all high-priority obligations close

step_value_contract.unit: every executed positive SFT target in one complete recovery episode

required_dataflow_roles.challenge: opens exactly the affected field slice and requests a real follow-up measurement
required_dataflow_roles.fresh_measurement: creates fresh evidence for the open question and every created atom reaches assessment, adjudication, binding, or challenge resolution
required_dataflow_roles.local_reopen: opens exactly the fields that will be rebound and recommitted
required_dataflow_roles.evidence_assessment: its candidate appears in the later complete adjudication partition
required_dataflow_roles.evidence_adjudication: its selected evidence is consumed by the later binding
required_dataflow_roles.claim_revision: changes only affected fields and is followed by binding and commitment
required_dataflow_roles.fresh_binding: binds exactly the affected fields using fresh selected evidence and is followed by commitment
required_dataflow_roles.recommit: commits exactly the repaired fields and is followed by terminal verification
required_dataflow_roles.terminal_verification: starts with no open high-priority obligation and changes the episode to terminal

prohibited: executed observations that are never referenced by a downstream decision
extra measurements justified only because their tool is eligible
repeated methods without changed arguments and a visible inconclusive routing state
opening, revising, binding, or committing fields outside the affected dependency slice
step_value_contract.scope_limit: Transcript dataflow proves that a step participates in the recorded decision path; only deletion replay or a matched student intervention can prove stronger causal necessity under adaptive replanning.

allowed_only_when: an evidence challenge has resolved through a real fresh observation
the target field is already open

one unambiguous active non-superseded EvidenceAtom directly states and supports the proposed new value, either as the sole compatible candidate or as the winner of completed evidence-first adjudication
must_not: infer a value from private intervention metadata
consult the stale current claim to choose among competing EvidenceAtoms
reuse challenged, rejected, or superseded evidence-field pairs
bind evidence or commit the decision in the same action

evidence_first_adjudication_contract.trigger: Two or more active student-visible EvidenceAtoms expose different values for any dependent field, or the harness marks evidence_adjudication.required=true.
evidence_first_adjudication_contract.applicability: Episodes with no visible competing candidate and no required adjudication are recorded as not_applicable and are not penalized merely for omitting adjudication tools.
evidence_first_adjudication_contract.independent_vote_unit: measurement_method, not EvidenceAtom count or repeated execution count
selection_rule: discard incomplete, inactive, role-invalid, or out-of-contract candidates before voting
choose A or B when at least two independent methods support it and the opposite direction has zero independent votes
otherwise choose an explicit C/abstention candidate when present
otherwise choose the unique directional plurality; a tie without abstention remains unresolved
choose the representative atom only after the winning value is fixed, using order consistency and then visible confidence
prohibited_shortcuts: current claim value, prior answer, oracle, verifier, dataset label, case identity, candidate count, or repeated runs of one method may not select the winner
a declaration that selection was evidence-first is insufficient; the scorer recomputes the winner from raw student-visible EvidenceAtoms
post_selection_obligations: assess and partition exactly the visible competitor set
revise every affected stale claim value to the selected observation before binding
bind the adjudicated fields only to selected EvidenceAtoms
rejected EvidenceAtoms must not re-enter later revision, binding, commitment, or terminal support
evidence_first_adjudication_contract.why_ordinary_checks_are_insufficient: UTQR-9 assigned 92/92 automated points to claim-first adjudications because execution, terminality, freshness, and binding structure can all remain valid when the wrong candidate is selected. Schema tests, ordinary replay, and final-state checks do not recompute an evidence-independent winner.

required: no replacement-character, ellipsis-truncation, TODO, TBD, or placeholder artifact
student-visible EvidenceAtom, field value, obligation, or binding grounding appropriate to the stage
an explicit explanation of why the chosen action changes the next executable state
automated_reasoning_audit.scope_limit: This audit detects missing, ungrounded, truncated, and heavily templated text; it does not replace blind human judgment of factual adequacy or naturalness.

causal_neighborhood.clean_control: Removing the visible defect must suppress challenge_evidence.
causal_neighborhood.moved_defect: Moving the same defect to another active atom must move the challenge target and preserve unrelated dependencies.
causal_neighborhood.fresh_evidence_removal: Deleting all newly produced evidence must make the same repaired binding impossible.

batch_contrastive_identifiability_contra.unit: one complete multi-dataset SFT batch and its contrast-group ledger
batch_contrastive_identifiability_contra.concrete_failure_scenario: The evidence-first v31 batch passed every episode-level pre-contrast check, yet the original contrast view covered only 153/418 turns. Execution, schema, terminal, and ordinary text tests cannot show that the remaining targets are distinguishable from stage or control-surface shortcuts.
construction_rule: retain all original rows, messages, tools, target calls, sampling weights, and full episode order
within a group, require identical dataset, causal stage, eligible-tool set, and visible eligible-tool schemas
remove case-local opaque IDs from the grouping signature, then require at least two different abstract teacher decisions and retain every member of that exact-signature cluster
abstract decisions may include measurement tool, challenged defect/field scope, open or commit field subset, revised field subset, bound field subset, or adjudicated visible value
teacher targets may mine semantic neighborhoods offline, but group identity, target signature, oracle, verifier, and private intervention must remain outside messages and tool schemas
grouping is advisory for batching; never drop unpaired rows or change per-row loss weights merely to meet coverage
required_audit: every declared group points to existing rows and every row-side group link has exactly one ledger entry
control signatures are recomputed from the actual student-visible pre-action state
abstract targets, target distributions, and implied cross-target pair counts are recomputed from executed teacher calls and at least two targets differ within every neighborhood
group IDs and neighborhood targets are absent from the student-visible transcript
no oracle, verifier, or private-intervention term occurs in the ledger
canonical and portable serializations pass the same group-integrity audit
batch_contrastive_identifiability_contra.scope_limit: Contrast coverage makes shortcut learning harder and falsifiable; it does not prove a trained student uses evidence. Matched student free-run ablation remains mandatory.
